en: A vintage black-and-white postcard shows an entrance to a garden or park, framed by stone pillars and lush trees. Several people in early 20th-century attire are standing around the gate, giving the scene an old-fashioned, historical feel. The bottom of the postcard contains printed text in Cyrillic and French, referencing 'морската градина', 'Varna', and 'Vue du jardin maritime'. The reverse of the card contains handwritten text in Bulgarian and an official purple stamp mentioning 'Ярослав В. Гочев ВАРНА'.
